rationale: Build on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with one compact structural change: add a learned per-dimension anchor-refresh gate inside the reverse recurrence loop. The decoder-output anchor now updates toward the latest recurrent state before each carry/replay, which can preserve the strong tail-anchor path while letting earlier recurrent passes see a better-conditioned target. This spends only a tiny control budget, stays compile-stable, survives the existing float-keep export path, and directly targets the local signal around reverse-tail anchor variants rather than repeating another scalar sweep.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
